assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The patient has documented supraventricular tachycardia
The patient reports recurrent episodes of palpitations
The patient reports brief neurological deficits
A cardiac event monitoring study is ordered to capture rhythm data during symptomatic periods
The study is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of transient ischemic events
The service is medically necessary to address the specific clinical indication of evaluating arrhythmic causes for the patient's reported symptoms
